data.title: MRI Appointment Confirmation – Lumbar Spine
data.summary: Radiologie am Beispielhof – MVZ confirms an MRI appointment of the lumbar spine (following a referral from the family doctor) for Thursday, 26 March 2026 at 2:20 PM at their practice in Beispielfeld.
data.explanation: This letter from the radiology practice confirms your MRI scan appointment. Bring your health insurance card, the doctor's referral, and any previous scans. Remove metal objects and magnetic cards before the scan, and call the practice beforehand if you have a pacemaker or other implants. If you cannot make the appointment, call to cancel at least 24 hours in advance — otherwise the practice may lose the reserved slot. No action is needed if you can attend as scheduled.
